title: 第9章 南禾雨 陆景的残本孤典
slug: 当不成赘婿就只好命格成圣

第9章南禾雨陆景的残本孤典
身穿蓝衫的少女与那位老妪，离开陆府，径自来到诸泰湖前，上了一叶小舟。
蓝衫少女腰间的长剑，在夕阳照耀下，竟然也发出微弱的蓝色光芒。
那老妪始终低着头站在蓝衫少女身后。
少女以轻纱覆面，看不清面容，但她眼神中的愁绪却颇为明显。
“小姐，这陆家三少爷虽然是庶出，又因为八年前的那桩旧事，在陆府中地位低，但论及气度，却要比那贪玩的陆琼还要更出彩许多。”
老妪出声道：“老爷、夫人知晓这陆景并非一无是处的不得宠庶子，也许会就此松口，同意这门婚事。”
蓝衣少女正是已经与陆景有婚约的南国公府南禾雨。
她身躯挺立，泛舟于湖上，却自有一股独特的气质，仿佛要与这平静的湖面融为一体。
老妪见自家堪称剑道天骄的小姐并不搭话，又犹豫了几息时间，这才在踌躇中开口道：“老爷也是为你着想，不忍心你成为南府的牺牲品。
他向来是希望你能够逃出宗族的枷锁，寻自己的剑道，去找那位洛公子……”
始终未曾开口的南禾雨轻咳一声，打断了老妪的话。
“父亲、母亲自然是为我着想。”南禾雨望着落日道：“只是，爷爷既然已经许下婚约，要让那陆景入赘我南府，甚至他的命契地书都已经由户籍司记录在南府外册上，那这陆景便已经彻底沦为贱籍。
父亲、母亲责怪爷爷未曾与他们商议便做出这种决定，执意想让我退婚。
可是既然已经有约，我如果写了一封休书退了这婚，于我倒是并无影响。
可是陆家三少爷，便因此彻底葬送了前程……”
南禾雨说到这里，长出一口气。
老妪也点头道：“并不仅仅只是葬送前程，恐怕往后一事，这比小姐还要小上一岁的陆景，就要活在别人的耻笑中。
起先沦为赘婿贱籍，后又被小姐嫌弃退婚，若是心性差一点的，只怕是要愤懑而亡。”
老妪说话间，眼神里也有几分不忍。

这份不忍，不光是对于她自小看大的南禾雨身不由己的不忍，其中恐怕还有对于陆景往后人生的不忍。
“老国公大抵也是无从选择了。”老妪心中自言自语：“如果国公府这一代子嗣有争气的，亦或者风眠公子尚在，老国公也不会如此大费周折，让小姐就此留在太玄京，执掌南府。”
那小舟上，并没有执桨者，可这一叶扁舟就好像被某种奇异的力量驱动，悄无声息地行进在湖中。
南禾雨闭起眼眸，一言不发。
足足过了许久，南禾雨突然睁眼。
却见她右手落在腰间剑柄。
剑气暗随流水去，落入诸泰湖风光中。
顿时间，三百剑光纷纷起，斩碎了湖中风光，也斩碎了湖中湖水。
湖水上的裂痕稍纵即逝，夕阳也在此时落下。
南禾雨的声音也透露出几分无奈。
“今日我自知无礼，却也还是前往陆府，为得就是要看一看陆家三公子。”
“我原本盼望着这陆家三公子不学无术，即便他非是贱籍，往后也前程无几。
如此一来，等我退了婚之后，便多在暗处给予他一些补偿，送他钱财产业，让他安心当一世富家翁，即便受上些人言，也总好过在那吃人不吐骨头的深府中，当一个遭人嫌恶的庶子。”
南禾雨似乎是在自言自语，又似乎是在倾诉于那老妪：“可我没想到，陆家三公子熟读典籍，看他眼神，胸中也有抱负。
我如果退婚，陆家三公子又当何处？有志士子沦为赘婿，已经是奇耻大辱，现在又……只怕被平白害了一条少年性命。”
那老妪皱纹纵横的脸上又出几分认同之色道：“陆家公子对于中正的见地脱俗不凡，不过这倒是其次，老妪我也听不太懂。
但观他陈述所学，确实有几分气度，若能始终精进，前途可期。”
南禾雨眼帘微垂：“既然爷爷已经立下约定，我身为南家人，自然要遵从，不能失信，也不能平白害了一位少年的前程……乃至性命。
入我南国公虽说仍然是赘婿身份，却不必受人耻笑，往后也仍有许多出仕或者修行的机会……”
老妪吃惊道：“小姐，伱已做了决定？可老爷夫人那里？”

“便说我去了陆府，一眼就相中了陆家三公子，自此不愿离京。”南禾雨面无表情。
“……是。”老妪心中又叹。
老爷与夫人知小姐甚深，自然知道小姐的心早已不在国公府，不在这座太玄京。
而在于那一座海，那一座岛，在那身穿白衣，指尖缠几两风雨剑气的洛公子身上。
想要瞒过他们，又谈何容易？
又一日，陆府。
陆漪正追在盛姿身后，两条扎了精致发花的辫子，一荡一荡。
“盛姐姐，你这是要去哪里？”
“你走的这般快，那一盒桃花酥岂不是都要碎了？”
盛姿身穿红装，面容白皙，但眉宇表情却显得英气不凡。
“陆漪，你莫要再惦记这一盒桃花酥，我要用来送礼的。”
“送礼？盛姐姐要给谁送礼？这陆府西院除了客房之外，住的都是些下人……嗯……盛姐姐要是找陆景？”
陆漪并不蠢笨，早从之前盛姿的话语，以及她执意要在琉光水榭看一看陆景的举动，陆漪都可以看出盛姿对于陆景颇有兴趣。
如今，甚至拿着那一盒陆漪假借她名头从老太君那里要来的桃花酥，往西院方向去，陆漪也就猜出盛姿的去处。
“盛姐姐，那陆景昨日不过是信口胡诌，连陆琼哥哥都说陆景说的与朱先生教的大有不同，你莫要被他哄骗了。”
盛姿微微一笑，走路的速度越来越快，裙摆飞扬。
陆漪并不知道，昨日从琉光水榭出来后，盛姿回到盛府，正好看到府中的儒学大客卿钟于柏。
她突然想起陆景对于中正的见解，心生好奇之下，就将陆景对于中正的理解一字不差的转述给钟于柏。
钟于柏当时惊为天人的表情，盛姿还记得清清楚楚，甚至连声追问这样的看法，究竟来自于哪一位大家、又或者哪一本残本孤典。
盛姿这才明白，昨日琉光水榭中，几乎所有人都被陆景的飞扬神采、不凡气宇所吸引，甚至有所折服。

可是当日在场的人里，并没有精通儒学者，她们并没有察觉出陆景那一套中正、天人合一理论的不凡。
“这种能令儒学名家都为之惊讶的见地，一定不是来自于年仅十六岁的陆景，也许陆景从陆府杂书中找到了什么难得的典籍。”
“我如果能借来这本典籍，钟大家也许能够教我几式马术，助我降住素踵。”
盛姿乐滋滋的想着，眉眼中还带着些许期盼。

Chapter 9 Nanheyu Lu Jing’s Fragmentary Canon
The girl in blue shirt and the old woman left Lu Mansion, went straight to Zhutai Lake, and boarded a small boat.
The long sword on the waist of the girl in blue actually gave off a faint blue light under the setting sun.
The old woman always stood behind the girl in blue shirt with her head lowered.
The girl's face was covered with gauze, so her face could not be seen clearly, but the sadness in her eyes was quite obvious.
"Miss, although this third young master of the Lu family is a concubine and has a low status in the Lu family because of the old incident eight years ago, in terms of magnanimity, he is much more outstanding than the playful Lu Qiong."
The old woman spoke out: "Master and Madam know that Lu Jing is not a good-for-nothing, unloved bastard, so they might relent and agree to this marriage."
The girl in blue is none other than Nan Heyu of the Duke of Nanguo Mansion, who is already engaged to Lu Jing.
She stood upright and was boating on the lake, but she had a unique temperament that seemed to blend into the calm lake.
When the old woman saw that her young lady, who was regarded as the genius of swordsmanship, did not speak to her, she hesitated for a few breaths, and then she said hesitantly: "I also think about you and cannot bear to have you become a victim of Nanfu.
He has always hoped that you could escape the shackles of the clan, find your own way of swordsmanship, and go find Mr. Luo..."
Nan Heyu, who had never spoken, coughed slightly and interrupted the old woman's words.
"Father and mother are naturally thinking about me." Nan Heyu looked at the sunset and said: "But since grandpa has made a marriage contract and wants Lu Jing to marry me in Nanfu, and even his life deed and land certificate have been recorded in the Nanfu external register by the Household Registration Department, then Lu Jing has been completely reduced to a lowly status.
My father and mother blamed my grandfather for making such a decision without consulting them, and insisted on wanting me to cancel the engagement.
But since we have already made an appointment, if I write a letter of divorce and cancel the engagement, it will have no effect on me.
But the third young master of the Lu family completely ruined his future because of this..."
When Nan Heyu said this, he let out a sigh of relief.
The old woman also nodded and said: "It's not just ruining his future. I'm afraid that in the future, Lu Jing, who is one year younger than the young lady, will have to live in the ridicule of others.
First, he was reduced to a son-in-law and a lowly status, and then he was rejected by the young lady and broke off the engagement. If he had a worse temperament, he would probably die of anger. "
As the old woman spoke, there was a bit of unbearability in her eyes.
This intolerance is not only the intolerance towards Nan Heyu, whom she has looked down on since childhood, but also the intolerance towards Lu Jing's future life.
"The old Duke probably has no choice." The old woman said to herself: "If the heirs of this generation in the Duke's Mansion are promising, or if Mr. Feng Mian is still alive, the old Duke will not go to such trouble to let the young lady stay in Taixuanjing and take charge of the Nanfu."
There was no one holding the oar on the small boat, but the small boat seemed to be driven by some strange force and moved silently in the lake.
Nan Heyu closed her eyes and said nothing.
After a long time, Nan Heyu suddenly opened his eyes.
But he saw her right hand fall on the hilt of the sword at her waist.
The sword energy secretly followed the flowing water and fell into the scenery of Zhutai Lake.
All of a sudden, three hundred sword lights rose up one after another, shattering the scenery in the lake and the water in the lake.
The cracks on the lake disappeared fleetingly, and the sunset also set at this time.
Nan Heyu's voice also revealed a bit of helplessness.
"I know I'm rude today, but I still went to the Lu Mansion just to take a look at the third son of the Lu family."
"I originally hoped that the third young master of the Lu family would be uneducated and incompetent. Even if he was not from a lowly position, he would have few prospects in the future.
In this way, after I break off the engagement, I will give him some compensation in secret, give him money and property, and let him live a peaceful life as a rich man. Even if he is criticized by some people, it is better than being a disgusted bastard in a deep house where people eat people without spitting out their bones. "
Nan Heyu seemed to be talking to himself, and also seemed to be confiding in the old woman: "But I didn't expect that,The third son of the Lu family was familiar with classics, and looking at his eyes, he also had ambitions in his heart.
If I break off the engagement, where will the third son of the Lu family be? It is already a great shame and humiliation for an aspiring scholar to become a son-in-law, and now... he is afraid that a young man's life will be lost in vain. "
The old woman's wrinkled face showed some recognition and said: "The Lu family's views on Zhongzheng are extraordinary, but this is secondary, I don't understand the old woman very well.
But looking at his statement of what he has learned, he does have some magnanimity. If he can always keep improving, he has a bright future. "
Nan Heyu lowered his eyes slightly: "Since grandpa has made an agreement, as a member of the Nan family, I must abide by it. I cannot break my promise, nor can I ruin a young man's future... or even his life."
Although the Duke of Nanguo is still a son-in-law, he does not need to be ridiculed by others, and there will still be many opportunities for officialdom or spiritual practice in the future..."
The old woman was surprised and said: "Miss, have you made a decision? But where is the master and his wife? "
"So I went to the Lu Mansion and fell in love with the third son of the Lu family at first sight, and I didn't want to leave the capital from then on. "Nan Heyu's face was expressionless.
"...Yes. "The old woman sighed in her heart.
The master and his wife know the young lady very well, and naturally they know that the young lady's heart is no longer in the Duke's Mansion, nor in this Taixuan Capital.
But it lies in that sea, that island, and in Mr. Luo, who is dressed in white and has a few taels of wind and rain sword energy wrapped around his fingertips.
How easy is it to hide it from them?
Another day, Lu Mansion.
Lu Yi was chasing after Sheng Zi, her two braids with delicate hair patterns swaying one after another.
"Sister Sheng, where are you going? "
"You left so fast, wouldn't that box of peach blossom cakes be broken into pieces? "
Shengzi was wearing a red dress and had a fair face, but her eyebrows looked heroic.
"Lu Yi, don't worry about this box of peach blossom cakes anymore, I want to use them as gifts. "
"Giving gifts? Who does Sister Sheng want to give a gift to? In addition to the guest rooms, the west courtyard of Lu Mansion is occupied by servants... Hmm... What if Sister Sheng wants to find Lu Jing? "
Lu Yi was not stupid. From Sheng Zi's words before and her insistence on seeing Lu Jing at Liuguang Water Pavilion, Lu Yi could tell that Sheng Zi was quite interested in Lu Jing.
Now, even taking the box of peach blossom cakes that Lu Yi asked for from the old lady under the guise of her name and heading towards the west courtyard, Lu Yi could guess where Sheng Zi was.
"Sister Sheng, Lu Jing was just talking nonsense yesterday. Even brother Lu Qiong said that what Lu Jing said was very different from what Mr. Zhu taught. Don't let him deceive you. "
Shengzi smiled slightly, walking faster and faster, her skirt flying.
Lu Yi didn't know that after coming out of Liuguang Water Pavilion yesterday, Sheng Zi returned to Sheng Mansion and happened to see Qing Zhong Yubai, the Confucian guest in the mansion.
She suddenly remembered Lu Jing's views on Zhongzheng, and out of curiosity, she relayed Lu Jing's understanding of Zhongzheng to Zhong Yubai word for word.
Zhong Yubai's shocked expression at that time and Sheng Zi could still be clearly remembered, and he even kept asking which master or which fragment of the ancient book this opinion came from.
Only then did Sheng Zi understand that almost everyone in the Glazed Water Pavilion yesterday was attracted and even impressed by Lu Jing's high-spirited spirit and extraordinary aura.
However, among the people present that day, there were no proficient Confucian scholars, and they did not realize the extraordinaryness of Lu Jing's theory of Zhongzheng and the unity of nature and man.
"This kind of insight that surprised even the famous Confucian scholars must not have come from the sixteen-year-old Lu Jing. Maybe Lu Jing found some rare classics from Lu Mansion Miscellaneous Books. "
"If I can borrow this classic, Mr. Zhong may be able to teach me some equestrian skills to help me lower my heel. "
Sheng Zi thought happily, with a little expectation in her eyebrows.
